reviews.title: It solved my radiator fitting problem.
reviews.comment: I've been trying to install a new radiator so I can get my PC on water, but the original 24 pin cable was so bulky thick and messy that it was preventing the radiator from fitting properly. I wasn't too happy with the idea of adding 12 more inches of cable to my ITX enclosure, but something needed to be done about the stock cable. With the extension, I was able to get a nice tight flat bend, and now the cable has a nice gap between the radiator. My only other Alternative was to pay a pretty high premium price to have custom shorter 24 pin cable made, needless to say I decided to try the value rout first and I'm glad I did. The cable is pretty well made and holds it's bend pretty easily. It's a little stiffer near the connections but it's pretty easy to flex in the center, this allowed me to rout most of the cable down along the side of the enclosure. So now I can get back to happy water cooling. Using a thermaltake core v1, with alphacool nexXxos 140, and corsair ML 140 fan.

reviews.title: Great for cable management!
reviews.comment: Sorry its a little hard to see in the pictures, but THATS THE POINT!!  Haha.  The power cable that came with the power supply was all different colors, and didnt match the theme of the computer at all.  This extension looks much better, or since you dont see it, doesnt look like anything at all!  Haha.  It serves its purpose perfectly. I would recommend buying a set of cheap plastic wire combs to keep these looking their best.  It would have been nice if they included a cheap set, but its not a deal breaker.  Still a good value!
